findings.motion: House: Third consideration and final passage (PN 1688)
findings.note: House roll call as printed ('Prokopiak'), linked to Jim Prokopiak (district 140) via the official 2025-2026 House member roll (identity step 2026-10-28).

Bucks County Beacon article (published 2025-10-03) lists him among Bucks County representatives who voted yea on HB 1099, which bans ghost guns (homemade, unserialized or undetectable firearms); the bill failed 101-102. Vote date is not given in the page text; the official roll call was not checked.

Same article lists him among those voting yea on HB 1859, an Extreme Risk Law letting police and family members seek removal of firearms from people in crisis; the bill failed 101-102. Official roll call not checked.

Same article lists him among those voting yea on HB 1593, which requires background checks on sales or transfers of all firearms regardless of barrel length; the bill passed 104-99. Official roll call not checked.
